_readme: Hand-maintained corrections for data/publications.json. This file always
wins over Google Scholar and over the Semantic Scholar / OpenAlex lookups,
so it is where you record anything the databases have not caught up with:
a paper that is accepted but not yet indexed, a venue name you want worded
differently, a thesis, a link you would rather point somewhere else.
'entries' is keyed by arXiv ID (preferred, stable) or by the paper title
(matched loosely: case and punctuation are ignored). Any field you list
replaces the generated one. Useful fields: venue, venue_kind
in press | preprint), url, doi. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so you
'venue_aliases' shortens long official venue names for display. The first
alias whose text appears in the venue wins, so list the specific ones first.
Delete an entry once the databases report the paper correctly on their own.
